name: baxter
description: Scrabble tournament manager. The cron entry keeps the local player table in step with the central CoCo player database; see plans/PLAN_COCO_PROGRAM.md (W4) and tournaments/roster_sync.py. --no-sync runs straight from the image's venv: without it uv rebuilds the Rust extension in every one-off container, because the Dockerfile's COPY lands fresh mtimes on the crate sources after uv sync.
